_comment: Trigger B: an SSH certificate past its validity window.
The rule NAME is load-bearing. The daemon's decision engine selects a
playbook by matching the rule name, and this one is chosen because it
contains both 'certificate' and 'expir'. Renaming the rule without
updating select_playbook() silently disables remediation - the webhook
still arrives and the daemon still answers 200, having done nothing.
size MUST be 1. The expiry publisher runs every 30 seconds, so a 2-minute
window holds four matching documents; a Mustache section over context.hits
would emit the key ID four times, concatenated, and the playbook would find
certificate_id and principal are not in the webhook payload defined by the
brief. They are lifted out of the matching document here because the
playbook refuses to guess which certificate to revoke.
name: SSH Certificate Expired
